From the owner
Whether an addition costs less usually depends on plumbing needs, foundation work, and whether it can reuse a wall or roofline that already exists. A bump-out that skips a full foundation can cost less than a room built from scratch, and converting a garage or porch may trim costs because the walls and roof are already there. Going up is different in Kamas. A second story tends to cost more since existing footings need review and the new roof has to handle heavy mountain snow loads. At Aspen Ridge Development, we work on additions around Kamas and the Wasatch Back, and we check what can be reused before pricing new work. Skipping new plumbing and reusing the roofline often keeps scope smaller. We can walk your site with you to show which type fits your home.

Why choose Cabinet Refacing + New Countertops? Save Money & Reduce Waste: Keep sturdy hardwood cabinet boxes in place while replacing doors, drawer fronts, and hardware with factory-finished wood or laminate. Durable Stone Surfaces: Pair your updated cabinets with non-porous Engineered Quartz or heat-resistant Natural Granite. Factory-Grade Finish: Unlike standard site-painted cabinets that chip or peel, factory-finished refacing holds up against steam, grease, and daily wear. Fast 3 to 5 Day Timeline: Get a total culinary makeover in a fraction of the time of a full gut remodel. Custom Upgrades: Add soft-close hinges, modern pull-out drawers, or matching kitchen islands for maximum storage. Don't spend tens of thousands on full demolition when you can get the exact same luxury look for much less.
